episodes.title: The Code
episodes.summary: In the fast-paced and cutthroat world of professional sports, hockey scout Matt Shade's top pick, Cory Sinclair, has a heart attack on the ice at the Intercontinental Professional Hockey League try-outs. The toxicology reports reveal he used performance-enhancing drugs. Knowing Cory would never resort to that, Shade begrudgingly teams up with private investigator Angie Everett to find out who sabotaged his young player. Through their new partnership, Shade is forced to examine who he has become and who he wants to be.

episodes.title: Mise en Place
episodes.summary: A high-profile murder in the sizzling-hot Toronto restaurant scene shows Shade and Angie how volatile partnerships and rivalries can get, just as they embark on creating a new one of their own.

episodes.title: The Money Shot
episodes.summary: When a multi-million dollar racehorse goes missing, Shade and Angie head to the track to find answers, and encounter unexpected complications along the way.

episodes.title: The Devil's Playground
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie search for an arsonist and killer in the Toronto Islands; Shade's ego grows with his newly-minted P.I. license.

episodes.title: The Six
episodes.summary: Hired by an unlikely source, Angie and Shade search for a missing minor, who's gotten caught up in a dangerous situation while hustling for fame.

episodes.title: Partners in Crime
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie go undercover to try to expose a con artist; Angie, Jules and Don give Shade romantic advice.

episodes.title: Karaoke Confidential
episodes.summary: A hipster hires Shade and Angie to protect him from danger.

episodes.title: I Do, I Do
episodes.summary: When a lifestyle company's CEO is threatened, Shade and Angie need to find the source, despite her insistence that everything is going according to her very complicated plan.

episodes.title: Disappearing Act
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie track a magician who escaped police custody; Shade receives a tantalizing offer.

episodes.title: Family Jewels
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie go undercover as an engaged couple when a family heirloom is stolen.

episodes.title: The Extra Mile
episodes.summary: The owner of a car racing team hires Shade and Angie; Angie and Shade adapt to their new roles.

episodes.title: Boardwalk Empire
episodes.summary: Zoe Chow hires Shade and Angie to find out who broke into her apartment.

episodes.title: The Frame Job
episodes.summary: A teacher is accused of an inappropriate relationship and Shade and Angie investigate.

episodes.title: Crimes of Fashion
episodes.summary: Fashion designer Sonia Valero hires Shade and Angie to guard her new collection.

episodes.title: Now You See Her…
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are hired to find a missing woman who died a year ago.

episodes.title: The PI Code
episodes.summary: A lawyer hires Shade and Angie to investigate jury tampering.

episodes.title: Between a Doc and a Hard Place
episodes.summary: Angie and Shade are hired to find out who's targeting a pro-bono medical clinic.

episodes.title: Six Feet Blunder
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are hired to find a missing body, but wind up uncovering a scheme to bury millions of dollars.

episodes.title: The Good Soldier
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie investigate the case of a missing Army Cadet.

episodes.title: Kissing the Canvas
episodes.summary: In the fast-paced world of female professional boxing, Shade and Angie try to avoid being sucker-punched.

episodes.title: Long Live the King
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are hired by the 'King' from Medieval Times after he believes he's been poisoned.

episodes.title: Getaway with Murder
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are hired by the owner of a luxurious rustic lodge to investigate an infidelity case. Thinking it'll be a breeze and a good opportunity for a mini-vacation, they invite Ken and Mel along to join them. But when their client ends up dead and the local sheriff proves to be out of his depth, they ditch their dates to solve the case – ultimately leaving them out in the cold.

episodes.title: A Fare to Remember
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are taken on a wild ride after picking up an unexpected fare during a routine sting operation.

episodes.title: Finding Leroy
episodes.summary: Maz's sister surprises Angie with a desperate request to help her recover a rare aquatic creature that went missing on her watch from Ripley's Aquarium.

episodes.title: The Hills Have Eyes
episodes.summary: Hired by a precocious young boy convinced his missing neighbor was murdered, thanks to suspicious footage from his new drone, Shade and Angie are forced to go undercover and play house in hopes of separating the truth from the gossip.

episodes.title: Look Who's Stalking
episodes.summary: Becca is back and concerned that a relentless stalker from her past has returned. She hires Shade and Angie to look into the dark world of media, fame, and celebrity obsession, in search of a dangerous super fan.

episodes.title: Brew the Right Thing
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie are hired by brewing brothers, who are concerned that someone is trying to sabotage their newly award-winning beer. What at first looks like simple corporate espionage, gives way to something more sinister fermenting in the suds.

episodes.title: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie's partnership is tested when a mysterious client hires them to recover a faulty prototype for a potentially dangerous new energy source. But when their plans go awry, and their client disappears, who will be left holding the bag?

episodes.title: Catch Me If You Can
episodes.summary: Behind bars, Angie meets an intimidating inmate.

episodes.title: Full Court Press
episodes.summary: When a compromising photograph is published on a gossip site, Shade and Angie are hired to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Cut and Run
episodes.summary: Angie's mother's new beau hires Everett and Shade, when his clinic's database is hacked.

episodes.title: The Life of Riley
episodes.summary: When a motorcycle shop owned by one of Angie's acquaintances is vandalized, Shade and Angie are called to investigate, only to find out that in this quiet suburban community, everyone has a secret.

episodes.title: The Grape Deception
episodes.summary: Angie's college roommate calls for help when a bottle of wine is stolen.

episodes.title: Hog Day Afternoon
episodes.summary: Shade ends up in the middle of a hostage situation in a high-rise office, while Maz attempts to control the situation on the ground.

episodes.title: Dance Dance Retribution
episodes.summary: When Becca calls on Shade and Angie to investigate a series of potentially supernatural accidents that threaten to derail her new TV special, the PI's find themselves tap dancing their way through the cut throat world of reality television. Previously titled "She Slices, He Dices"

episodes.title: The Conroy Curse
episodes.summary: Deputy Conroy needs help with a murder case.

episodes.title: It Happened One Fight
episodes.summary: Angie and Shade investigate the mysterious collapse of Zoe's Cousin.

episodes.title: Tex Therapy
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie investigate Tex, a charming man with amnesia who may be linked to an expensive art heist.

episodes.title: Aye, Aye, Tonya
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie think they're uncovering a simple case of infidelity when they're swept onto the high seas aboard a pirate-themed cruise ship where costumes, treasure, and eye patches are just a cover for a more insidious scheme.

episodes.title: Glazed and Confused
episodes.summary: Angie's long-time nemesis Norm Glinski fakes his own death, and hires her and Shade to investigate.

episodes.title: Family Plot
episodes.summary: Shade and Angie investigate the seemingly paranoid claims of a wealthy and ailing patriarch who believes that a series of accidents are attempts on his life.

episodes.title: Gumbo for Hire
episodes.summary: The proud owner of a new food truck, Don finds himself the prime suspect in a robbery that took place at a grocery store during the Langtree Food Truck Festival.

episodes.title: The P.I. Vanishes
episodes.summary: When Angie is kidnapped en route to a weekend getaway with her long-distance boyfriend, Tex, Shade partners up with the Seattle PI to track down the woman they both love.

episodes.title: The Proof Is Out There
episodes.summary: A concerned husband lands at the Everett and Shade agency fearing that his wife is no longer his wife. Shade and Angie follow the woman and amass a series of clues that lead them to suspect she's involved in many things.

episodes.title: All's Fair in Love and Amor
episodes.summary: After a Mexican telenovela is plagued with near-fatal accidents targeting the lead actors, Shade and Angie are pulled headfirst into the melodrama of the soap opera's revival and uncover a decades-old murder.

episodes.title: Tappa Kegga Daily
episodes.summary: Zoe's away at a blood-spatter conference, so when a local sorority girl gets mixed up in a valuable comic-book theft, Shade and Angie lean on Liam, Jules, and Becca for help.

episodes.title: Under Par-essure
episodes.summary: A stalker targets a female golf pro during a celebrity golf tournament; Shade and Angie try to discover the culprit; Romance blooms between Shade and actress Willow Maitland; Angie seeks out some much-needed fun.

episodes.title: Blueprint for Murder
episodes.summary: A high-rise office cleaner witnesses a murder in the new condo building next door, prompting Shade and Angie to dig into the dark side of the success-obsessed urban professional.

episodes.title: A Star is Torn
episodes.summary: In the midst of the Toronto International Film Festival, a famous action star hires Shade and Angie to track down a missing heirloom in time for his big premiere.

episodes.title: Smoke Gets in Your Eyes
episodes.summary: Becca's new documentary is put on hold when the jazz club she's featuring is set on fire by an unknown arsonist, the club's famous owner goes missing and the police begin searching for him, claiming that he tried to destroy his own club.

episodes.title: The Perfect Storm
episodes.summary: It's the day of Danica and Kate's wedding, and a sudden storm strands the wedding guests on a Muskoka island where a plane crash and a wounded pilot unravel a mystery involving buried treasure and mistaken identities.

episodes.title: Drop Dead Carny
episodes.summary: In the colourful lights of a midway, Shade and Angie stumble upon the body of a carnival worker and are thrust deep into the world of travelling carnies, an eerily accurate psychic and a ring of thieves.

episodes.title: In the Arms of Morpheus
episodes.summary: During her recovery from an injury, Angie hears someone threatened from her hospital room while under the influence of a drug. No one believes her.

episodes.title: School's Out for Murder
episodes.summary: At Angie's high school reunion, she drags Shade along so she doesn't have to confront her ex-BFF, Jada Berry, alone; after a body ends up on the dance floor, it's up to the PE crew to solve the mysterious murder.

episodes.title: Dead Air
episodes.summary: When local radio therapist, Dr. Rohan Love, starts acting strangely and spending huge sums of money, his wife Meera hires Shade and Angie to find out what secret he's hiding.

episodes.title: Gone in 60 Minutes
episodes.summary: Shade's precious Porsche is stolen at a luxury car show and he suspects his old hockey rival Mark "Lytnin'" Lyte might be to blame; Meanwhile, Angie struggles with PTSD.

episodes.title: Murder They Wrote
episodes.summary: When a young writer close to fame and fortune is threatened and then a famous guest drops dead, Shade, Angie and Tex find themselves following a trail of clues that lead them into a world of jealousy, desperation and greed.

episodes.title: Angie Get Your Gun
episodes.summary: While visiting Nora and her serious boo, Rory, Shade and Angie learn that a pair of Billy the Kid's cowboy boots have gone missing from the local museum; when Rory gets fingered as the prime suspect, Angie and Shade race to find Billy's secret.

episodes.title: Smart Home Alone
episodes.summary: A financial advisor calls the team for help when she suspects her high-tech smart house has developed a mind of its own. After Shade and Angie are nearly steamed to death, they suspect someone is hacking into her smart home system.

episodes.title: Queen's Gambit
episodes.summary: A simple robbery case at a local drag club ends up being more complicated than expected. As Shade and Angie race to stop a bank heist, they admire their clients' ability to be true to themselves and express their feelings.
